content_evals.prompt: Review a clean Atlas skill and APM pull request.
content_evals.with_skill: Run atlas-contract and skill-agent-contract, return concrete coverage, and explain the clean recommendation.
content_evals.without_skill: A generic review may return an unsupported looks-good response.

content_evals.prompt: Review a Python CLI change that can escape an Atlas path boundary.
content_evals.with_skill: Run atlas-contract, python-cli, and security-gitops; publish the diff-backed Blocker inline and prioritize it in the summary.
content_evals.without_skill: A generic review may miss Atlas root-escape and focused-compile invariants.

content_evals.prompt: Review a documentation-only Atlas pull request.
content_evals.with_skill: Run only atlas-contract and provide a concise evidence-backed recommendation.
content_evals.without_skill: A generic review has no deterministic roster or cost evidence.

trigger_evals.query: Give this Atlas pull request a multi-lens review.
Check this branch before I ask for review.
Look for contract and security issues in this PR.
Have the Atlas reviewers inspect these changes.
Review the current pull request and summarize the risk.
Review this single paragraph for grammar.
